role: structured Gaussian Markov TD development; not nonlinear MARL confirmation
model: constant-feature TD on a stationary Gaussian AR(1) Markov reward process; discount zero; known persistence; unknown mean and spatial variances
fixed_comparator: Each fixed-q is given free true-context optimal spacing and step, full budgets, and no calibration charge. This is an intentionally stronger diagnostic comparator, not a deployable baseline.
primary_metric: exact conditional terminal MSE, averaged over fresh training streams after random paid calibration
paired_unit: calibration seed; aggregate all 360 public contexts within seed before paired comparisons
interior_population: public exact paid oracle has q in {2,4} and at least a 3% risk gap to the best action at another q; determined analytically before calibration outcomes
stopping_rule: Any mandatory development failure stops this experiment without changing thresholds, dropping cells, or using reserved confirmation seeds.
gpu_authorization: No GPU study is authorized by this CPU model alone; actual MARL response and estimator transfer must be qualified separately.
